subject: general
question: Which was India’s first venture into interplanetary space?
solution:
Correct answer is __**MOM.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mars Orbiter Mission (MOM) or Mangalyaan**, is a space investigation started by the Indian Space Research Organization on **November 5, 2013.** 
 
• Mangalyaan was** India's first interplanetary mission.**
 
• The primitively-built space investigation has been in the Martian orbit since **September 24, 2014.**
 
• It was profitably started by the **Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) C-25 **from the **Satish Dhawan Space Center** in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f98ff133ec1d82023299a745d778e4452c63e76d9ba7c62a2dbfda77a5c4264.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandrayaan-1, **India's first mission to Moon, was started profitably on **October 22, 2008,** from SDSC SHAR, Sriharikota.​ 
 
• GSAT-31 is a high-production telecommunication satellite started by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).**
 
• **ASTROSAT** is India's first devoted **multi-wavelength space observatory**.
